newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Thursday, after some contracts erased earlier gains by the afternoon session, local traders said.
Prices ranged from 20 yen lower to 150 yen higher, with the benchmark July 1998 contract up 80 yen at 14,490 yen a tonne.

All contracts gained during the morning session, due to the CBOT market's price gains overnight, traders said. Technical selling capped the topside of some contracts during the afternoon session, traders said.
The spot September corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was trading at $2.63 per bushel at 0840 GMT, against $2.62-1/4 at Wednesday's close.
Spot August CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system were at $7.54 per bushel at 0840 GMT, against $7.56-1/2 at Wednesday's close.
